purpose: Define what may bridge utilization evidence gaps so the system cannot inflate useful-work coverage with heartbeats or no-op bookkeeping.
git_audit_minimum_rule: A commit that changes only state/ACTIVITY.json is heartbeat-only and cannot be a substantive evidence point.
semantic_rule: Changing another file is necessary for the simple Git audit but not sufficient in principle; future auditors should reject no-op/busywork changes even outside ACTIVITY.
anti_gaming: Do not split one trivial change into many commits solely to satisfy the 120-second gap threshold.
Do not create unrelated filler work to manufacture evidence points.

Prefer naturally checkpointable meaningful units; if useful work genuinely requires >120 seconds without a durable intermediate result, mark the interval measurement uncertain rather than fake progress.
